meta.note: Parent system: trace-commons flat glass + Near AI logo kit + Apple Liquid Glass/HIG, Unity Foundations/App UI and Material 3 Expressive research. Gateway themes re-synced to trace-commons main@e2a1ad9d7 (2026-11-03); NDS-22 to NDS-49 from the owner's product sessions (research/sessions-2026-11.md). 2.0.0: the trace-light, trace-dark themes and trace-purple are renamed gateway-light, gateway-dark and gateway-purple (NDS-48).

tokens.name: scene
tokens.usage: The ground behind a window or page: the desktop stand-in on web and the first-run backdrop. Never under text.

tokens.name: scene-warm
tokens.usage: The lighter center of the scene gradient (radial, scene-warm to scene).

tokens.name: scene-glow-1
tokens.usage: Web scene glow, top left (radial). Decorative; never under text without a pane.

tokens.name: scene-glow-2
tokens.usage: Web scene glow, bottom right. Decorative.

tokens.name: scene-glow-3
tokens.usage: Web scene glow, center. Decorative.

tokens.name: scene-glow-brand
tokens.usage: The one brand glow drawn straight on the scene: the welcome glow rising behind a composer, the first-run corner glow. Near AI blue at low alpha; never under body text without a card.

tokens.name: scene-card
tokens.usage: A card drawn straight on the scene with no pane under it: the first-run stage's settings card, a welcome screen's card.

tokens.name: scene-control
tokens.usage: A neutral control drawn straight on the scene (first-run Back). Lighter than `control`, whose dark well vanishes on the navy scene.

tokens.name: scene-control-hover
tokens.usage: `scene-control` under the pointer.

tokens.name: scene-rule
tokens.usage: A rule or dashed line drawn straight on the scene, stronger than `rule`.

tokens.name: glass-veil
tokens.usage: The tint painted over a pane's native material (or over backdrop blur on web) so text holds 4.5:1 over any desktop. Navigation layer only.

tokens.name: pane-fill
tokens.usage: The flat fill painted over the veil on every pane.

tokens.name: pane-base
tokens.usage: A pane where no native material or blur exists (modal backing, Android and Windows panes).

tokens.name: pane-opaque
tokens.usage: A pane under Reduce Transparency, forced colors or low-power mode: solid. Also the chart and the reference ground for status marks.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: A card on a pane (painted, never blurred).

tokens.name: card-quiet
tokens.usage: A quiet card: inspector sections, menus inside panels, notices.

tokens.name: card-hover
tokens.usage: Replaces the card fill under the pointer on an interactive card.

tokens.name: card-on-opaque
tokens.usage: A card on an opaque ground (pane-base, pane-opaque): phone and tablet screens, Reduce Transparency, opaque content panes. In dark the glass card matches the opaque pane and would vanish.

tokens.name: card-quiet-on-opaque
tokens.usage: A quiet card on an opaque ground.

tokens.name: card-nested
tokens.usage: A card drawn on a card: the inner container that holds a detail or an estimate inside a card. One step from the card it sits on; never a third level.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: The neutral (glass) button, picker and toolbar-group fill.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Replaces the control fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: control-on-menu
tokens.usage: A neutral control or pill drawn on a menu, popover or other floating surface, where `control` would vanish into the floating fill.

tokens.name: control-on-menu-hover
tokens.usage: `control-on-menu` under the pointer.

tokens.name: control-on-selection
tokens.usage: A neutral control or pill drawn on a selected row (`selection`). Its label and glyph take `text-on-accent`.

tokens.name: control-on-selection-hover
tokens.usage: `control-on-selection` under the pointer.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: A recessed track: segmented-control track, legend cell, unchecked checkbox.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: A text field, text area or select well.

tokens.name: consent
tokens.usage: The consent block and code block ground.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: A popover, node card or tooltip on the floating layer (over its own blur). 94%: opaque enough that rows and pills under it never show through (owner, 2026-10-05 web and 2026-10-19 macOS).

tokens.name: menu
tokens.usage: A menu or dropdown on the floating layer (over its own blur). 94%, for the same reason as `popover`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a sheet or drawer.

tokens.name: scrim-modal
tokens.usage: Behind a modal, over an 8px blur of the window content.

tokens.name: inactive-dim
tokens.usage: Painted over a pane when its window is not key, so background windows read darker.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: One device pixel between rows inside a list or table. Never around a container.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Under a modal header, over its footer, under tab rows, and section rules.

tokens.name: edge-hc
tokens.usage: The 1pt solid edge every painted surface gets under increased contrast.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Replaces an unselected row's fill under the pointer. Never over a selected row.

tokens.name: toggle-off
tokens.usage: The 16 to 18% ink behind things that are off or empty: a progress track, the spinner ring, the subtle badge. The switch track uses `toggle-track-off`.

tokens.name: toggle-track-off
tokens.usage: A switch track when off. In the dark themes it is 38% white so the navy off knob (`toggle-knob-off`) holds 3:1 on it (owner, 2026-10-22).

tokens.name: toggle-knob-off
tokens.usage: A switch knob when off. White in the light themes; in the dark themes the same navy as the on knob (`text-on-accent`), so on and off differ by track and position, not by knob.

tokens.name: toolbar-glyph
tokens.usage: A toolbar button glyph.

tokens.name: toolbar-glyph-off
tokens.usage: A toolbar glyph whose pane is hidden (3:1 on the control). Below the floor, kept from the source and flagged: gateway-light 2.27:1 (toolbar-glyph-off on control); gateway-dark 2.63:1 (toolbar-glyph-off on control).

tokens.name: toolbar-expanded
tokens.usage: A toolbar button whose menu is open.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, body and values on every pane, card, field, popover and menu.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting lines, labels, inactive tabs. Same grounds as text-primary.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Captions, eyebrows, axis labels, timestamps. Same grounds as text-primary.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: A field's prompt. Text, so it holds 4.5:1 on field.

tokens.name: text-placeholder-on-opaque
tokens.usage: Placeholder text on an opaque ground (`pane-opaque`, `card-on-opaque`, phone and web shells with no glass). Quieter than `text-placeholder`, which is already at the 4.5:1 floor over the worst glass ground. Never on glass.

tokens.name: text-on-status
tokens.usage: The count on badge-fill.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one action and every selected state: primary button, selected segment and row, switch on, checkbox on, radio on. Holds 3:1 against every ground.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: The accent fill while pressed (8% darker, never a fade).

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and glyphs on accent, accent-pressed and menu-hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, accent eyebrows and accent text on every ground text-primary uses.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent marks that are not text: series, step-progress nodes, tab ember, promo edges. 3:1 on pane-opaque.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: A tinted background behind accent content (accent tags, the selected filter chip ground).

tokens.name: tab-ember
tokens.usage: The 2pt line under the selected main tab, fading at both ends.

tokens.name: tab-ember-halo
tokens.usage: The glow rising from the tab ember behind the selected title.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, 2px outside the control. 3:1 against every ground.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: A selected list or table row (with text-on-accent).

tokens.name: menu-hover
tokens.usage: The highlighted menu item (with text-on-accent).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive status mark (dot, glyph): on, watching, verified. Always beside words.

tokens.name: positive-text
tokens.usage: Positive status as text, on every ground and on positive-tint.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Positive tag ground. A notice never takes a tint; its tone is the dot in its title.

tokens.name: proof-text
tokens.usage: The word of a passed proof (Verified) and the seal's ink, on `proof-tint`. Calmer than `positive-text` so a proof never reads as a neon success.

tokens.name: proof-tint
tokens.usage: The ground of a passed proof: the ProofTag pill, the proof pill in a header, the seal-match box. Opaque, so it reads the same on glass and on paint.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Caution status mark: ask me, pending, needs a look. Always beside words.

tokens.name: caution-text
tokens.usage: Caution status as text.

tokens.name: caution-tint
tokens.usage: Caution tag ground. Never a notice or card fill.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical status mark: failed, leaves for an outside model, no proof. Always beside words.

tokens.name: critical-text
tokens.usage: Critical status as text, and the inline alert line.

tokens.name: critical-tint
tokens.usage: Critical tag ground. Never a notice or card fill.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Off, never, not used. A mark only: never for text.

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Neutral tag and chip ground.

tokens.name: destructive-text
tokens.usage: The destructive button label and destructive menu items.

tokens.name: badge-fill
tokens.usage: The count badge (decisions owed), with text-on-status.

tokens.name: surface-chart
tokens.usage: The opaque plot ground of every chart. Series are validated against it; charts never plot straight on glass.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Recessive gridlines and the axis rule.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Categorical series 1, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Categorical series 2, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Categorical series 3, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Categorical series 4, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

tokens.name: data-5
tokens.usage: Categorical series 5, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

tokens.name: data-6
tokens.usage: Categorical series 6, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

tokens.name: data-7
tokens.usage: Categorical series 7, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

tokens.name: data-8
tokens.usage: Categorical series 8, in fixed order (never cycled). Validated for color-vision deficiency on adjacent pairs and 3:1 on surface-chart.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Overlay strokes and fills at an alpha: white on dark, black on light.

tokens.name: brand-blue
tokens.usage: The "AI" of the Near AI wordmark and the secondary lockup. Logos, illustration and brand moments; in the dark themes it is also data-1 and accent-soft. Not text on a light ground (2.9:1 on pane-opaque).

tokens.name: brand-sky
tokens.usage: Near AI Sky, from the near.ai/brand palette. The light steps of brand illustration (the marketing site's dithered art ramp). Logo, illustration and marketing use only; never text or controls.

tokens.name: brand-deep-blue
tokens.usage: Near AI Deep Blue, from the near.ai/brand palette. Mid steps of brand illustration. Illustration and marketing use only.

tokens.name: brand-tile
tokens.usage: The ground of the Near AI tile (app-icon lockup). Logo use only.

tokens.name: brand-tile-dark
tokens.usage: The tile ground of the dark app-icon appearance (macOS and iOS Icon Composer documents). App icons only.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: The "N" monogram on the color tile. Logo use only.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The "near" wordmark in the color lockup on light grounds. Logo use only.

tokens.name: gateway-purple
tokens.usage: The old Trace purple: Gateway's dark accent until 2026-10-20 (NDS-22). It survives only in the old Trace mark and Gateway's Shared data series (#8a3dff dark, #7a2cf5 light). Never on controls.

groups.name: Compact: macOS and desktop
groups.note: The trace-commons scale, every step a macOS text style at its default size, so it follows the system text size. Dense desktop and pro tools.

styles.name: mac-eyebrow

styles.name: mac-caption
styles.usage: Sub-lines, helper text, timestamps, inline alerts. Maps to: subheadline.

styles.name: mac-label

groups.name: Expressive: hero moments
groups.note: At most one or two per product, on marketing and empty hero states, never inside dense tools.

styles.name: hero-display

styles.name: hero-figure
styles.usage: A single headline figure (verified share, balance). Tabular digits.

spacing.note: A 2-step scale to 16, then 20 and 24 (trace-commons s1-s10), extended on the 8 grid for web and touch layouts, plus the named layout measures every shell shares.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Toolbar-group padding, icon-to-badge nudge, dense field gap (Unity 2px between fields).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Label above a field, menu-row inset, note line spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Inline gap: dot to label, icon to label, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a bar, menu padding, list-row column gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between panes and between cards (pane-gap, card-gap).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Pane padding, card padding (vertical), field horizontal padding plus 2.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Card padding (horizontal), modal body vertical padding, overlay inset on a map.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Inspector horizontal padding, phone side margin (M3 compact margin), sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Gap above an action bar, first-run step inset, section gap in settings.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Tablet and web content margin (M3 medium+), large card padding, section gap.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Web section spacing, gap between pane groups on large screens.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Empty-state block spacing, hero padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Web page section spacing.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Hero and marketing section spacing (expressive only).

tokens.name: pane-gap
tokens.usage: Between floating panes in a window (and the window edge on web).

tokens.name: pane-padding
tokens.usage: Inside a pane.

tokens.name: card-padding-y
tokens.usage: Card vertical padding (quiet card 10).

tokens.name: card-padding-x
tokens.usage: Card horizontal padding (quiet card 12).

tokens.name: card-gap
tokens.usage: Between cards in a column.

tokens.name: inline-gap
tokens.usage: Between an icon or dot and its words.

tokens.name: inspector-padding-x
tokens.usage: Inspector pane horizontal padding.

tokens.name: inspector-padding-y
tokens.usage: Inspector pane vertical padding.

tokens.name: modal-inset
tokens.usage: Minimum gap between a modal and the window edge.

tokens.name: modal-inset-top
tokens.usage: Gap above a modal (clears the title bar and traffic lights).

tokens.name: dense-padding-left
tokens.usage: Dense inspector left padding (Unity Inspector: 18 left, 4 right, 8 top and bottom).

tokens.name: dense-indent
tokens.usage: Dense tree and inspector indent per nesting level (Unity, max 6 levels).

tokens.name: tree-indent
tokens.usage: Regular tree indent per level, after an 8px inset (trace-commons).

tokens.name: margin-compact
tokens.usage: Page margin below 600px (phones).

tokens.name: margin-medium
tokens.usage: Page margin from 600px (tablets, narrow web).

tokens.name: margin-expanded
tokens.usage: Page margin from 840px; panes separate with a 24px spacer.

radius.note: Flat glass radii (the baseline). Nested corners are concentric: inner radius = outer radius minus the padding between them, never less than radius-tile.

tokens.name: radius-pane
tokens.usage: Panes, modals, edge rail, menu-bar panel (flat; classic 16).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, node cards (flat; classic 14).

tokens.name: radius-card-quiet
tokens.usage: Quiet cards and menus (flat; classic 12).

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Fields, large tool tiles, edge-rail tiles (flat; classic 8).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Small tiles, menu items, kebab ground, day-graph chips. The concentric floor.

tokens.name: radius-checkbox
tokens.usage: Checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-dense
tokens.usage: Dense controls in pro-tool panels (Unity Editor buttons and fields).

tokens.name: radius-state-pill
tokens.usage: The 44pt menu-bar state pill.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: A window drawn by the app on web and Windows/Linux (the #1146 window radius).

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and side sheets on touch (top corners only; M3 extra-large).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, wells, segments, chips, tags, badges, switches: every capsule.

shadow.note: Flat glass: one soft drop shadow for anything that floats; nothing painted inside a pane casts a shadow. The edge-classic-* shadows are the optional Classic (expressive) treatment.

tokens.name: shadow-float

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: A modal over its scrim.

tokens.name: shadow-check
tokens.usage: The unchecked checkbox and radio ring (the only rim flat glass keeps).

tokens.name: edge-classic-pane
tokens.usage: Classic (expressive) theme only: the specular top highlight and bottom shade on a pane.

tokens.name: edge-classic-control
tokens.usage: Classic (expressive) theme only: a glass control's highlight, shade and contact shadow.

tokens.name: edge-classic-cta
tokens.usage: Classic (expressive) theme only: the primary button highlight and its accent glow (Gateway purple glow shown).

tokens.name: spring-spatial

tokens.name: spring-spatial-slow
tokens.usage: Large spatial moves: full-screen and window-level transitions (M3 standard slow spatial). Stiffness 300, damping ratio 0.90; settles in 484 ms (use duration-spring-spatial-slow). Native: spring(stiffness, damping) on SwiftUI and Compose.

tokens.name: spring-effects
tokens.usage: Color, opacity and blur changes that must not overshoot (M3 standard default effects). Stiffness 1600, damping ratio 1.00; settles in 231 ms (use duration-spring-effects). Native: spring(stiffness, damping) on SwiftUI and Compose.

tokens.name: spring-expressive
tokens.usage: Hero moments only, one or two per product: a bouncy expressive move (M3 expressive fast spatial). Stiffness 800, damping ratio 0.60; settles in 360 ms (use duration-spring-expressive). Native: spring(stiffness, damping) on SwiftUI and Compose.

tokens.name: spring-ember
tokens.usage: The main-tab ember gliding between tabs (Gateway: response 0.35, damping fraction 0.85). Stiffness 322, damping ratio 0.85; settles in 488 ms (use duration-spring-ember). Native: spring(stiffness, damping) on SwiftUI and Compose.
